data.name: Hasanur
data.gender_notes: Hasanur is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Hasanur is a Sanskrit name derived from the Hindu deity Vasuki, who is the king of all serpents and the lord of rain. He holds the rain-giving cloud in his hood, and the gods churned the ocean with his body to obtain the elixir of immortality. The name Hasanur carries the meaning “Lord of the serpent” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Hasanur usually hope their child will grow to embody lord of the serpent and live with faith, good character and purpose.
